name: Polanger Category Story Carousel for WooCommerce
author: Polanger

sections.description:
Polanger Category Story Carousel for WooCommerce is a beautiful and modern way to display your WooCommerce product categories. Inspired by Instagram stories, this plugin creates an eye-catching carousel with animated gradient borders that will engage your customers.

Features:

  • Instagram-style story carousel for WooCommerce categories
  • Multiple border animation styles (Gradient, Solid, Pulse, Rainbow, Dashed Rotating)
  • Customizable hover effects (Zoom, Rotate, Glow, Bounce, Shake)
  • Shadow effects (Soft, Medium, Hard, Colored)
  • Center mode with focused item highlighting
  • Fully responsive with separate column settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Navigation arrows and pagination dots
  • Autoplay with customizable speed
  • Category filtering (Parent only, Child only, All)
  • Include/Exclude specific categories
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatible
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/polanger-category-story-carousel directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Story Carousel to configure the plugin settings.
  4. Use the shortcode [pwfb_category_carousel] to display the carousel on any page or post.
sections.faq:
What is the shortcode to display the carousel?

Use [pwfb_category_carousel] to display the carousel. You can also override settings with shortcode attributes like [pwfb_category_carousel columns="4" autoplay="yes"].

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I customize the border colors?

Yes, you can customize up to 5 gradient colors in the Design tab of the plugin settings.

Is the carousel responsive?

Yes, you can set different column numbers for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
